fields.description: Leave blank to apply to employees of all grades. A row with a grade takes precedence over rows without one.
fields.label: Grade

fields.description: Minimum years of service, inclusive. E.g. 2 covers employees with 2 or more years of service.
fields.label: From (Years of Service)

fields.description: Upper limit of years of service, exclusive. E.g. 2 means 'below 2 years'. For a continuous table, set this equal to the next row's From.
fields.label: To (Years of Service)
